title: Data Center Critical Facility Engineering Fundamentals
summary: Core principles of high-availability data centers, tier ratings, electrical path single points of failure (SPOF), and cold aisle management.
quizChecklist: Explain the difference between Tier III Concurrent Maintainability and Tier IV Fault Tolerance.

title: High Voltage Switchgear (11kV) Safe Switching & LOTO Protocol
summary: Step-by-step training on safe switching procedures, permit-to-work systems, arc flash risk categories, and VCB rack-in/out protocols.
quizChecklist: List the five safety rules for dead working on high voltage electrical equipment.

title: Emergency Operating Procedure: Blackout & Manual Gen Synchronization
targetAudience: All NOC, SOC, and Critical Facility Staff
summary: Hands-on simulation protocol for utility grid total collapse, manual generator bus paralleling, and critical UPS load protection.
quizChecklist: Within what time limit must standby generators accept critical building load following grid collapse?
